system.description: The dead dragon empress, Bahamut's opposite and a goddess of power held by whoever is strong enough to seize it; her followers await her return.
system.summary: The dead dragon empress, Bahamut's opposite and a goddess of power held by whoever is strong enough to seize it; her followers await her return.
commandments: Respect the hierarchy, obey, and plot your rise.
Loyalty and custom make weak foundations; do not rely on them.
directives: Power underlies everything; without it you are nothing.
Life is a ladder climbed only by the strong, and passing someone means their fall.
Strong lead and weak follow; never obey a lesser, never strike a superior.
Shape how others see you to become great.
Use fear as a shield that deters threats and sharpens your vigilance.

cults.name: The Cult of the Dragon Reborn
cults.summary: The ancient public face of Tiamat worship, recruiting gently through community centers and indoctrinating 'retreats'.

cults.name: The Council of Wyrms
cults.summary: Surviving dragon lords who direct her minions from hiding and gather pieces of her corpse, demanding a fragment from anyone seeking promotion.
